WHY IT IS EMPTY, AND IT IS NOT THE REASON WO-2 WAS EMPTY.
WO-2 registered nothing because the decision had not been made. THIS file is empty because THE DECISION HAS BEEN MADE AND ITS CONTENT CANNOT BE READ FROM THIS PROJECT.

PO-DECISIONS-0025 ruling 1 ratifies 'trinity:pbgv2:crash_detector:indicator_dial_mapping:v1' — approximately 24 indicators across two dials, each with a dial binding, a tier weight (x3/x2/x1) and a polarity — and that artefact resolves nowhere reachable from this repository. Measured at BL-20260824T070245Z-0157 and raised as Q30.
WHAT IS OWED BEFORE A ROW MAY BE WRITTEN HERE:

Q30  the ratified mapping artefact's CONTENT, reachable from this project. Until it is, every row would be invented product meaning (PBG-AUTH-005), and inventing the ingredient set is the exact thing CD-D-005 reserves to the Product Owner.
Q31  Redis. PO-DECISIONS-0025 r2's architecture sentence names it; BLUEPRINT section 2's container set does not declare it. Open, not resolved.

THE STALENESS CEILING. *** THIS ONE BLOCKS ROWS DIRECTLY. *** crash_detector.staleness.STALENESS_WINDOW_CEILING_SECONDS is 900.0 seconds (fifteen minutes), DERIVED from PID.md section 5's ratified assurance latency budget. PO-DECISIONS-0025 ruling 6 requires a WIDE window for private credit stress and ruling 4 registers SLOOS's NDFI leg as manual-QUARTERLY. MEASURED: quarterly, monthly, daily and even hourly windows are all REFUSED by that ceiling; only 900 seconds and below are admitted. The bound was NOT widened to make the rows fit, because it is derived from a ratified clause and reversing a derivation to suit the data is the invention CD-RULE-003 forbids. See admit_staleness_window in src/crash_detector/source_registry.py, which carries the full measurement and the analysis of why a FEED-LIVENESS bound and a DATA-CADENCE window are two different quantities sharing one unit.

THE POLARITY VOCABULARY. Ruling 1 says every indicator carries a polarity and does not say what the admissible values are. crash_detector.source_registry.Polarity declares the two values a monotone SIGN can take, as an engineering derivation. A non-monotone indicator would not fit it.
HOW A ROW IS SHAPED WHEN 16B WRITES ONE. Every key set below is asserted by EQUALITY, so a missing provenance and an invented 'weight' both fail the same clause:
source_id                  the registered source this mapping is for

dial_bindings              a list. ONE ENTRY PER BOUND DIAL, each with 'dial_id' and its OWN 'polarity'. AN INDICATOR THAT MOVES BOTH DIALS IS TWO ENTRIES WITH TWO POLARITIES, NEVER ONE BLENDED ENTRY (PO-DECISIONS-0025 r7: two dials never blended). There is no field for a second dial inside one entry.

provisional_tier           'x3' | 'x2' | 'x1'. PROVISIONAL is in the type's name because ruling 3 says these are starting values calibrated by backtest and trusted on no assertion. It is an enum member and not a number, so it cannot be multiplied by anything until that backtest happens.
staleness_window_seconds   declared PER INDICATOR, never global (PO-PRODUCT-0001 R2). Subject to the ceiling above.

provenance                 'ruling_ref', 'mapping_artefact', 'mapping_version', 'stands_for' — all required and all non-empty. An unexplained mapping cannot be admitted (PID doctrine section 3.6); stands_for is the admission ticket, not documentation.

wiring_state               'WIRED' | 'PENDING'. SLOOS's NDFI leg is manual-quarterly and will be PENDING for real. A PENDING row asked to render as a value RAISES (PO-DECISIONS-0025 r4: 'never a false green').

NO IDENTIFIER IN THIS FILE MAY CARRY THE TEST MARKER 'PLANT_SYNTH_'. Every fixture in this project's tests uses obviously-synthetic identifiers carrying that marker, and tests/test_indicator_mapping.py asserts that none of them appears here.
